stories.title: ‘You’re not a weak person’: Mayport sailor shares his recovery journey as veteran suicides increase
stories.summary: A new VA report shows Florida had the most veteran suicides in 2024. A Navy sailor in recovery urges veterans to ask for help.

stories.title: St. Augustine teen faces rare bone cancer and amputation as community rallies around him
stories.summary: A 15-year-old St. Augustine football player is facing osteosarcoma and amputation. His family is turning to faith, treatment and a community rallying around him now.

stories.title: Seven Northeast Florida KFC properties listed in franchisee bankruptcy filing
stories.summary: Many of the locations have already closed, and the franchisee seeks to exit its leases and abandon those properties.

stories.title: Ask Anthony: Can Jacksonville's Main Street Wholesale Warehouse get a second chance?
stories.summary: After nearly 20 years serving the people of Jacksonville, Main Street Wholesale Warehouse is closed. Now, a community is fighting to give it a second chance.

stories.title: Charges in St. Johns County fake voter guide case dismissed for a second time
stories.summary: The charges were dismissed by the same judge who dismissed the case in circuit court, arguing that the statute of limitations had passed.

stories.title: Jacksonville mother files federal lawsuit against JSO, claims officer killed son during mental health crisis
stories.summary: The lawsuit alleges that JSO Officer Bumgarner shot the woman's son multiple times in the back while he was attempting to flee.

stories.title: Beaches Energy Services to increase electric rates on Jan. 1: What customers should know
stories.summary: Beaches Energy Services will raise electric rates on Jan. 1, 2027, due to rising infrastructure costs, with a 1.4% annual increase until 2029.

stories.title: Streetlights are out on Jacksonville highways. Here's why
stories.summary: Copper thieves are causing street light outages along I-295, I-95, SR-9B and the First Coast Expressway.

stories.title: JSO investigating after man found dead inside home on Jacksonville's Westside
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office said the circumstances surrounding the incident are unknown and are being investigated.

stories.title: Fleming Island father raises money for daughter's headstone with Lynyrd Skynyrd guitar fundraiser
stories.summary: A Fleming Island father is raising $4,000 for his 16-year-old daughter’s music-note headstone through a fundraiser featuring a guitar signed by Johnny Van Zant.

stories.title: No charges to be filed after 14-year-old on e-moto killed in Clay County crash
stories.summary: The Florida Highway Patrol determined that the other drivers were not at fault for the June 11 death of a 14-year-old rider on Sandridge Road.

stories.title: City of St. Augustine monitoring weather conditions ahead of annual Light-Up! Night celebration
stories.summary: Potential flooding and safety concerns could dampen St. Augustine's annual Nights of Lights kickoff.
